nodes.description: Mapping of user balances; written in constructor, _transfer and burn.
Nested mapping of ERC20 allowances; read in transferFrom, written in _approve.
Blacklist/limit flag mapping toggled by giveReflections and toggleReflections, checked in _transfer.
Owner address; controls onlyOwner modifier and is reassignable via changeOwner/RenounceOwnership.
Boolean trading switch set to true in openTrading.
Total supply; increased (not decreased) by the misnamed burn function.
Pair address created in openTrading; also assigned to router in setReflections.
Router/pair gate address used by _transfer to restrict sells; set in setReflections.
Flag explicitly set false in setReflections; participates in _transfer sell restriction.
Block number when trading opened; used for anti-snipe Transfer emission logic in _transfer.
Hardcoded privileged market address that bypasses onlyOwner, balance and amount checks.
Constructor assigning the full supply to msg.sender and setting owner.
onlyOwner function that overwrites the owner address.
onlyOwner function that sets owner to the dead address.
onlyOwner function marking arbitrary addresses in the bots blacklist loop.
onlyOwner function removing addresses from the bots blacklist loop.
onlyOwner function redirecting router to the pair and disabling balances1.
onlyOwner function creating the pair, adding liquidity via external router call, then setting tradingOpen and openBlock.
ERC20 transfer that delegates to _transfer using _msgSender().
ERC20 transferFrom that performs _transfer then decreases allowance.
ERC20 approve that delegates to _approve.
Core internal transfer holding blacklist, router-gate, amount-cap checks and unchecked balance updates.
onlyOwner function named burn that actually mints: increases _totalSupply and recipient balance.
Internal allowance writer used by approve/transferFrom/openTrading.
Reads _balances for an account.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, transfers and balances.
Miner-influenced timestamp passed as router deadline in openTrading.
Ownership can be reassigned by changeOwner, additionally reachable by the hardcoded marketAddy.
burn increases _totalSupply without bound, an unlimited minting backdoor for the owner.
_balances[recipient] += amount executed without overflow guard inside _transfer.
External createPair/addLiquidityETH/approve calls executed before trading flags are updated.
bots flag can block transfers of arbitrary addresses, enabling honeypot behaviour.

edges.reason: msg.sender receives the initial supply and becomes owner in the constructor.
onlyOwner compares stored owner and msg.sender (or marketAddy) before reassigning ownership.
RenounceOwnership is gated by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
giveReflections is gated by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
toggleReflections is gated by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
setReflections is gated by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
openTrading is gated by onlyOwner and uses owner as liquidity recipient.
burn (mint) is gated by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
_msgSender() is passed as sender into _transfer by transfer.
_msgSender() is used as spender for allowance reads and writes in transferFrom.
_msgSender() is used as the allowance owner in approve.
block.timestamp is passed as the router deadline, making the call timestamp dependent.
Constructor writes the full supply into _balances[msg.sender].
Constructor sets the owner state variable to msg.sender.
changeOwner overwrites the owner storage slot.
RenounceOwnership overwrites the owner storage slot.
giveReflections sets bots[recipient] = true, enabling arbitrary blacklisting.
toggleReflections sets bots[recipient] = false.
setReflections assigns the pair address to the router gate variable.
setReflections sets balances1 = false, tightening the sell restriction permanently.
openTrading stores the newly created pair address.
openTrading flips tradingOpen to true.
openTrading records the opening block number.
External router/pair calls (createPair, addLiquidityETH, approve) occur before tradingOpen and openBlock are finalized.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom executes _transfer before adjusting allowance.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
_transfer reads and writes sender and recipient balances in _balances.
_transfer requires !bots[sender] && !bots[recipient], a blacklist gate on every transfer.
When recipient == router, balances1/_balances1/marketAddy conditions decide if the transfer is allowed.
_transfer reads balances1 to authorise transfers to the router gate.
_transfer compares openBlock + 4 against block.number to zero out early Transfer events.
_balances[recipient] += amount is executed without overflow protection in _transfer.
burn performs _totalSupply += amount, increasing supply without any cap.
burn credits _balances[account] += amount.
The function named burn executes an unbounded mint on the total supply.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender] = amount.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
changeOwner hands full owner privileges to an arbitrary address.
giveReflections flips the bots blacklist flag for arbitrary addresses.
recipient argument flows from transfer into _transfer.
amount argument flows from transfer into _transfer.
sender argument flows from transferFrom into _transfer.
recipient argument flows from transferFrom into _transfer.
amount argument flows from transferFrom into allowance subtraction.
spender argument flows from approve into _approve.
amount argument flows from approve into _approve.
sender parameter indexes _balances and the bots blacklist in _transfer.
recipient parameter indexes _balances and is compared against router in _transfer.
amount parameter is compared against the hardcoded cap and checked against senderBalance in _transfer.
account parameter receives newly minted tokens in burn.
amount parameter is added to the total supply in burn.
account parameter indexes the _balances mapping in balanceOf.
recipients_ array elements are written into the bots blacklist loop.
recipients_ array elements are cleared from the bots blacklist loop.
_owner parameter is written into the owner storage slot.
senderBalance caches _balances[sender] before the unchecked subtraction in _transfer.
currentAllowance caches the allowance before the unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
Loop index i drives iteration over recipients_ in the blacklist loop.
Local router instance is stored and used for liquidity and pair creation calls in openTrading.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter node is only meaningful inside the transfer function body.

Recipient argument is local to the transferFrom execution scope.
Amount argument is consumed by transferFrom allowance arithmetic.
Spender argument is forwarded straight into _approve.
Amount argument is forwarded straight into _approve.
Sender argument indexes balances and the blacklist inside _transfer.
Recipient argument indexes balances and the router gate inside _transfer.
Amount argument is validated against the cap and senderBalance inside _transfer.
Account argument is credited with newly minted tokens in burn.
Amount argument is added to _totalSupply in burn.
Account argument is a read-only lookup key in balanceOf.
Array argument only exists to populate the bots blacklist in the loop.
Array argument only exists to clear the bots blacklist in the loop.
New owner argument is directly written into the owner state variable.
Temporary cache used solely for the unchecked balance update in _transfer.
Temporary cache used solely for the unchecked allowance update in transferFrom.
Loop counter used only to iterate the blacklist recipients array.
Local router handle used only for the external calls performed by openTrading.
